title: 2 arrested in P2.72 million drug bust in Mabalacat

blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — Police arrested two suspected drug pushers who allegedly yielded 400 grams of shabu worth P2.72 million in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Dau in Mabalacat City on Thursday night. In a statement, the Central Luzon police said the operation targeted a 35-year-old man classified as a “high-value individual” under the government’s campaign against illegal drugs.
